findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the nozzles and holders of the two sodas gun at the bar to be soiled. Discussed with PIC and the soda guns and holders were cleaned to sight of touch. Ensure that food-contact surfaces and NonFOOD-contact surfaces such as the soda guns and their holders are monitored and cleaned at a regular frequency to avoid contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.11: The ice machine is observed to have an accumulation of mold in the corners of the equipment. Facility PIC is taking a sanitizer rag to clean and sanitize the immediate issues and is calling a service to have the ice machine taken apart and cleaned completely. Ensure the ice machine is cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain it clean.  
4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The triple sink and the hand washing sink in the back room are in need of caulking where the metal meets the wall and where the sink basin meets the wall. Ensure these surfaces are sealed properly to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: The bar top black strip was observed to have spots with exposed wood. Ensure these surfaces are painted or sealed to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface.
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Hand washing sink in the bar area was not stocked with soap or paper towels. Hand washing sinks must have soap and paper towels available at all times. These items were provided during the inspection to correct the violation. 

6-301.11  (Pf) Liquid hand soap not provided at the hand washing sink. Provide liquid soap at hand washing sink. Reference 6-301.11.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12  (Pf) Disposable paper towels not provided at the hand washing sink. Provide disposable paper towels at hand washing sinks. Reference 6-301.12.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
1) Beverage tubing for the soda gun appears to run through the in use ice bin that is used for beverages. 

2) Observed what appears to be an unpainted/unsealed 2x4 underneath the bar above the sinks. Paint or seal wood so that it is non absorbent. 

3) The area of the bar top where the rubber mats sit is particle board that is in poor condition in some areas. When the rubber mats are lifted up and on some of the exposed edges when the mats are in place, raw particle board is showing. Paint or seal so it is smooth, non absorbent and easily cleanable. 

4-204.16  (C) Beverage tubing passes through the ice bin. Beverage tubing installed in contact with ice may result in condensate and dripping, contaminating the ice. Replace the tubing with an integral cold plate. Reference 4-204.16.
findings.citation_text: 4-101.19  (C) Nonfood-contact surfaces are no longer easily cleanable. Repair with an corrosion-resistant, non absorbent and smooth material meeting National Sanitation Foundation/ANSI certification for use within a food service facility.  Reference 4-101.19.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment: Facility uses both quaternary ammonium and chlorine sanitizer, but only the chlorine test strips are available at the time of the inspection. Facility will use the chlorine sanitizer packets when preparing sanitizer until the quaternary ammonium test strips can be provided to test concentration of sanitizer when using the tablets.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14  (Pf) Test kits or other devices are not available to the employees to measure sanitizing solution concentration. Provide a test kit or other measuring device so the employees can measure concentrations and ensure proper sanitization. Avoid a concentration of sanitizer that is too high, which can be toxic. Reference 4-302.14.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: Floor behind the bar is in poor repair--wood covering is missing in the area in front of the hand washing sink and it appears as though the subflooring is showing. Floor is sagging toward the hand washing sink behind the bar. This does not seem to be sturdy and is not smooth and easily cleanable. Repair flooring behind the bar.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.11  (C) Floors were found in a state of disrepair, or not to be smooth and easily cleanable. Except as specified in Section 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are smooth and easily cleanable.  Reference 6-201.11.
